svg.title: The call's flow: one cancellation in the shop, from its steps to the copy its caller receives
svg.desc: The shop cancels order o1, which holds the pending items i1 and i2, with the batch B-7, on a set built with recordTrail(). Every step and hook of the call shares one flow. The order's root step takes its hop, and its cancel action puts cancellation = B-7, then cascades CANCEL to both items under COLLECT. Each item's step takes its hop, and its restock action reads the batch and the order through flow().entity(Order.class), then puts restock:i1 or restock:i2. Each write comes after the hop of its step, and the trail lists each hop with the instant it was taken. The commit writes CANCELLED for the three entities. The applyRestock hooks then run in hop order and apply each item's restock; a hook can also put and remove values, and nothing undoes those writes. Once the hooks and the watch reactions ran, the flow is frozen into outcome.flow(): the three values, the order as its entity and the three hops. A rollback drops what came after its savepoint: when a step fails into its route, its hop and its writes are dropped with those of the steps it cascaded to, while what earlier steps wrote stays, and the recovery hop carries the Recovery; without a route, the step is dropped the same way and aborts with UnhandledFailureException. When i1 is PACKED, it has no CANCEL edge: its COLLECT element aborts and is dropped, with no hop and no write; the step of i2 still takes its hop and puts restock:i2; then COLLECT aborts the call, nothing commits and no hook runs, and the failure's flow holds cancellation and restock:i2, with the hops of o1 and i2 and a final Failed entry. A call that returns Outcome.Rejected ends its trail with a Rejected entry, and one that throws a CallFailedException with a Failed entry, each with an instant read when the call ended. The flow lives for one call: a watch reaction, or a call that a hook starts, has a flow of its own.
